instruction: Navigate to recreation.gov and find the 'Next Available' dates column in the campground listings table.

metadata.explanation: Very similar to the original task, this variation targets the 'Next Available' column header (index 2) instead of the specific content. The original task looks for dates for Diamond while this just verifies the column header exists. Uses existing Chrome parsing functions (active_tab_html_parse and check_direct_json_object).
